svg.title: Bazaar roadmap: Beta stages to v1.0.0 Zuhal
svg.desc: A vertical timeline of nine Beta stages, each listing its named features with shipped, in progress or planned status, ending at the v1.0.0 Zuhal readiness gate.
svg.text: Roadmap: from Beta to v1.0.0 Zuhal
Beta stages in order. v1.0.0 ships when the owner judges Bazaar ready, not on a date.
v1 scope still open (display 1.0.0). Anything tentative is marked *.
